activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 7 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Go on answering means that the speaker continues the same activity.
cards.explanation: Go on plus gerund continues an activity.

cards.statement: Forget seeing the film means that the person definitely did not see it.
cards.explanation: Forget seeing means the person does not remember the experience; it may have happened.

cards.statement: Regret informing always means that the speaker is about to announce bad news.
cards.explanation: Regret informing usually expresses regret about a past act.

cards.statement: In Remember to charge the recorder, charging is a task that should happen.
cards.explanation: Remember to do refers to a task.

cards.statement: Mean working late can describe a consequence of a new schedule.
cards.explanation: Mean plus gerund expresses what a situation involves.

cards.statement: Forget to lock the door means that the person failed to lock it.
cards.explanation: Forget to do means the required action did not happen.

cards.statement: Regret to inform is normally used to introduce a formal announcement.
cards.explanation: Regret to inform is a conventional formal notice formula.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 8 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Go on to explain normally means repeat exactly the same point without moving forward.
cards.explanation: Go on to explain usually marks a later stage or topic.

cards.statement: Try restarting the router guarantees that the repair will succeed.
cards.explanation: Try doing suggests a method but does not guarantee success.

cards.statement: Try changing the password suggests an experiment rather than a guaranteed result.
cards.explanation: Try doing suggests a method to test.

cards.statement: Try to open the jammed drawer focuses on an effort to achieve an action.
cards.explanation: Try to do focuses on attempting a result.

cards.statement: Mean to call describes a consequence rather than an intention.
cards.explanation: Mean to call describes an intention.

cards.statement: In I remember charging the recorder, the speaker is giving a reminder for the future.
cards.explanation: Remember charging refers to a past experience.

cards.statement: Go on to discuss normally signals a later step in a talk or explanation.
cards.explanation: The to-infinitive marks a transition to the next point.

cards.statement: Remember plus a gerund can refer to a completed past experience.
cards.explanation: Remember meeting someone describes a past experience.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: Stop to answer the phone can mean interrupting another activity for that purpose.
cards.explanation: The to-infinitive expresses the purpose of the pause.

cards.statement: Regret to announce is especially common in formal notices.
cards.explanation: It is a conventional formal announcement formula.

cards.statement: Remember to post the letter normally describes a past memory.
cards.explanation: Remember to post introduces a task, not a past memory.

cards.statement: Forget locking the gate and forget to lock the gate necessarily report the same event.
cards.explanation: The gerund concerns memory of an action; the infinitive concerns failure to do it.

cards.statement: Mean to send and mean sending always have the same meaning.
cards.explanation: Mean to do expresses intention, while mean doing expresses implication.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.
